title: Meeting recordings disappeared from the meeting chats
scenario: Recordings vanish after a retention policy was shortened: a policy change and missing items, but nothing about signing in.

events.title: Recordings gone
events.text: Hello, meeting recordings from the last weeks have disappeared from the meeting chats. Last week our compliance officer changed the retention policy for Teams recordings from 120 days to 14 days. Could that be the reason? Everybody can still sign in and use Teams without any trouble.

events.title: Re: Recordings gone
events.text: Hello, very likely yes: a 14-day retention policy removes recordings that are older than 14 days. To confirm, which meeting dates are missing?

events.title: Re: Recordings gone
events.text: Everything older than 14 days. Meetings from 20 May to 12 June are gone, newer ones are there.

events.title: Re: Recordings gone
events.text: That matches the new setting. Deleted recordings can be restored from the recycle bin for 93 days by an administrator. Ask your OneDrive administrator to search the deleted items of the meeting organisers and restore the recordings you need.

events.title: Re: Recordings gone
events.text: We restored them all. We will raise the policy to 60 days. Thank you.

events.title: Closing note
events.text: Recordings were removed by a retention policy that was shortened to 14 days. Restored from the recycle bin by the customer's administrator. No sign-in or access problem was involved.
